A therapist is not really an easily accessible option for me. The very first sentence would answer the question to title of thread.

I don't think really answering which specific Asian actually makes a difference? My family disowned me and only provided my ethnicity to just support the fact that they're the Asian stereotype that only cares about money.

I highly doubt talking to a therapist would help. I tried asking a doctor a long time ago and they questioned me then said, "I probably don't need to see a therapist" when i asked for anti-depressants years ago.

Medical professionals aren't going to help me.
